short_summary: Document describes an event: The Emerge Innovation Best-in-Show Solution Presentation for Payer Challenges, a pitch competition for healthcare innovators tackling payer challenges.
long_summary: The document is a presentation for the Emerge Innovation Best-in-Show Solution Presentation for Payer Challenges event, taking place on Tuesday, March 4, 2025, at Caesars Forum 131. It is part of the Emerge Innovation Experience. The event features three best-in-show innovators presenting solutions to payer challenges such as member engagement, data analytics, and healthcare affordability. Target audience includes investors, entrepreneurs, and startup leaders.
